sentences.en: On a chilly April morning in 2007, a nightmare unfolded on a college campus in Virginia.
sentences.zh: 2007年4月一个寒冷的早晨，弗吉尼亚州的一所大学校园里上演了一场噩梦。

sentences.en: A 23-year-old student, acting alone, opened fire in a dormitory.
sentences.zh: 一名23岁的学生单枪匹马在宿舍里开枪。

sentences.en: He shot and killed two students.
sentences.zh: 他开枪打死两名学生。

sentences.en: Then he walked across campus and began killing people in an engineering building.
sentences.zh: 然后他穿过校园，开始在一栋工程学大楼里杀人。

sentences.en: The sound of gunfire was caught on a student's cell phone.
sentences.zh: 枪声被一名学生的手机录了下来。

sentences.en: We weren't sure what it was.
sentences.zh: 我们当时不确定那是什么声音。

sentences.en: It was gunshots.
sentences.zh: 那是枪声。

sentences.en: But for a while we thought it would have been construction.
sentences.zh: 但有一段时间我们以为是施工发出的声音。

sentences.en: and we heard this horrible scream and laughter.
sentences.zh: 然后我们听到了可怕的尖叫声和笑声。

sentences.en: Tina Harrison was a student in the building.
sentences.zh: 蒂娜·哈里森是该大楼的一名学生。

sentences.en: So we were sitting in the classroom and basically panic broke out.
sentences.zh: 所以我们当时坐在教室里，基本上陷入了恐慌。

sentences.en: All we could hear was people screaming,
sentences.zh: 我们能听到的只有人们的尖叫声、

sentences.en: laughter and more screaming.
sentences.zh: 笑声以及更多的尖叫声。

sentences.en: And I counted 24 gunshots within a minute
sentences.zh: 我在一分钟内数出了24声枪响

sentences.en: and I lost track after that.
sentences.zh: 之后我就记不清了。

sentences.en: I just started praying.
sentences.zh: 我只是开始祈祷。

sentences.en: By the time the assault ended, 32 people were dead.
sentences.zh: 袭击结束时，已有32人死亡。

sentences.en: The gunman took his own life.
sentences.zh: 枪手自杀身亡。

sentences.en: The shooting at Virginia Tech was quickly seared into our minds
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚理工大学的枪击案迅速深深烙印在我们的脑海中

sentences.en: as one of the deadliest mass shootings in U.S.
sentences.zh: 成为美国历史上

sentences.en: history.
sentences.zh: 最致命的枪击案之一。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, it's been followed by many other school shootings,
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，此后又发生了许多起校园枪击案，

sentences.en: including the killing of 17 students in Parkland, Florida.
sentences.zh: 其中包括在佛罗里达州帕克兰杀害17名学生的事件。

sentences.en: In all these cases, the news media has struggled to convey the sheer scale of the massacre.
sentences.zh: 在所有这些案件中，新闻媒体都难以传达这场大屠杀的庞大惨烈规模。

sentences.en: There is terror and then sorrow today at the campus of Virginia Tech.
sentences.zh: 今天，弗吉尼亚理工大学校园内充满了恐惧和悲伤。

sentences.en: It's an act of evil on a scale that we've never seen in this country before.
sentences.zh: 这是一起我们国家前所未见的恶劣行径。

sentences.en: Four hours after the news began to break,
sentences.zh: 在新闻开始传出四个小时后，

sentences.en: Blacksburg, Virginia, is still in shock from its wounds,
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚州布克斯堡仍沉浸在伤痛之中，

sentences.en: and so is much of the country.
sentences.zh: 全国大部分地区也是如此。

sentences.en: But even as the country mourned,
sentences.zh: 但就在全国哀悼之际，

sentences.en: people began to ask why campus officials
sentences.zh: 人们开始质问为什么学校官员

sentences.en: hadn't been more proactive.
sentences.zh: 没有采取更积极的行动。

sentences.en: Why hadn't they spotted the warning signs?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们没有发现警告信号？

sentences.en: Why hadn't they locked down the school
sentences.zh: 为什么他们在宿舍发生第一起枪击案后

sentences.en: after the first shooting in the dorm?
sentences.zh: 没有封锁学校？

sentences.en: At a press conference, campus police tried to explain.
sentences.zh: 在新闻发布会上，校园警察试图进行解释。

sentences.en: We had information from witnesses
sentences.zh: 我们从目击者那里获得的信息

sentences.en: and the evidence at the scene that led us to believe
sentences.zh: 以及现场的证据让我们相信

sentences.en: the shooter was no longer in the building and more than likely off-campus.
sentences.zh: 枪手已经不在大楼里，多半已经离开校园。

sentences.en: Reporters grilled officials, who at times seemed lost for words.
sentences.zh: 记者们对官员们进行了严厉质问，他们有时显得无言以对。

sentences.en: Chief, can you outline your lockdown policy for the university?
sentences.zh: 警长，您能概述一下贵校的封锁政策吗？

sentences.en: Are you saying that do we have a policy to lock down the campus?
sentences.zh: 您的意思是，我们是否有封锁校园的政策？

sentences.en: Yeah, like when?
sentences.zh: 对，比如什么时候？

sentences.en: Under what circumstances do we do it?
sentences.zh: 在什么情况下我们会这么做？

sentences.en: What's your time frame?
sentences.zh: 你们的时间框架是什么？

sentences.en: It's not in my communications plan.
sentences.zh: 这不在我的沟通计划里。

sentences.en: Eventually, the state of Virginia and the university paid victims' families
sentences.zh: 最终，弗吉尼亚州和该大学向受害者家属

sentences.en: more than $11 million to settle lawsuits.
sentences.zh: 支付了超过1100万美元以达成诉讼和解。

sentences.en: Across the nation, universities scrambled
sentences.zh: 全国各地的大学纷纷采取行动

sentences.en: to improve their security protocols.
sentences.zh: 以改善其安全协议。

sentences.en: Many added expensive upgrades to emergency alert systems
sentences.zh: 许多学校为紧急警报系统进行了昂贵的升级

sentences.en: and hired new police officers
sentences.zh: 并聘请了新的警官

sentences.en: to stay on top of possible danger.
sentences.zh: 以防范潜在危险。

sentences.en: A weariness took hold on college campuses.
sentences.zh: 一种疲惫感在大学校园里蔓延开来。

sentences.en: A subtle fear was in the air,
sentences.zh: 空气中弥漫着一种微妙的恐惧，

sentences.en: a low-grade buzz of anxiety.
sentences.zh: 一种低强度的焦虑情绪。

sentences.en: People weren't taking chances.
sentences.zh: 人们不再抱侥幸心理。

sentences.en: At schools like Southern Illinois University in Edwardsville,
sentences.zh: 在诸如位于爱德华兹维尔的南伊利诺伊大学等学校，

sentences.en: small things that were out of place led to intense scrutiny.
sentences.zh: 一些微小的不寻常之处都会招致严格的审查。

sentences.en: His car was discovered, parked in a very conspicuous,
sentences.zh: 他的车被发现停在一个非常显眼、

sentences.en: a very unusual no-parking area at the university here in Edwardsville.
sentences.zh: 非常不寻常的、位于爱德华兹维尔大学的禁停区域。

sentences.en: And they found, you know, visible in the car, a note.
sentences.zh: 他们发现，你知道的，车里显眼处放着一张便条。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, we explore a complicated case that unfolded
sentences.zh: 本周的《隐藏的大脑》中，我们将探讨一个错综复杂的案件，它发生在

sentences.en: in the months after the Virginia Tech shooting.
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚理工大学枪击案之后的几个月里。

sentences.en: It was so complicated that even today, years later,
sentences.zh: 它是如此复杂，以至于时至今日，多年以后，

sentences.en: people still disagree about what really happened.
sentences.zh: 人们对当时究竟发生了什么仍然意见不一。

sentences.en: At the heart of the case was this question.
sentences.zh: 这个案件的核心是这样一个问题。

sentences.en: How can we know, really know, what's happening inside another person's head?
sentences.zh: 我们怎么能知道，真正知道，另一个人的脑子里在想什么？

sentences.en: Perception, reality, and judgment.
sentences.zh: 感知、现实与判断。

sentences.en: Three months after the Virginia Tech massacre, an Illinois gun dealer picked up the phone
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚理工大学大屠杀三个月后，伊利诺伊州的一名枪支经销商拿起电话

sentences.en: and called the Federal Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, and FirearMs.
sentences.zh: 拨打了美国烟酒枪炮及爆裂物管理局的电话。

sentences.en: He told an agent that he was worried about a client who was trying to purchase guns.
sentences.zh: 他告诉一位特工，他担心一个试图购买枪支的客户。

sentences.en: It was the first time he'd ever made a report to the ATF in, I think, about 10 years of being a gun seller, a gun dealer.
sentences.zh: 这是他当了大约10年枪支经销商以来，第一次向烟酒枪炮及爆裂物管理局举报。

sentences.en: Tom Gibbons is the Madison County, Illinois, state's attorney.
sentences.zh: 汤姆·吉本斯是伊利诺伊州麦迪逊县的州检察官。

sentences.en: Tom says the man who'd contacted the gun dealer was agitated and adamant.
sentences.zh: 汤姆说，联系枪支经销商的那名男子情绪激动且态度坚决。

sentences.en: He said he needed the guns quickly.
sentences.zh: 他说他需要尽快拿到枪。

sentences.en: And what he was purchasing was unusual.
sentences.zh: 而且他购买的东西很不寻常。

sentences.en: He was buying three low-cost, exact same models of a gun, a semi-automatic handgun, a .380 caliber.
sentences.zh: 他买了两款低成本、完全相同的枪，一种半自动手枪，口径.380。

sentences.en: The gun dealer explained that the man, whose name was Olutosin Odawale, had purchased the guns wholesale on the Internet and needed him, a licensed transfer agent,
sentences.zh: 枪支经销商解释说，这名男子名叫奥卢托辛·奥达瓦莱，通过互联网批发购买了这些枪支，并需要他（一名有执照的转让代理人）

sentences.en: to complete the transaction.
sentences.zh: 来完成这笔交易。

sentences.en: Olutosin's background check was clean, but the gun dealer felt something wasn't right.
sentences.zh: 奥卢托辛的背景调查没有问题，但枪支经销商觉得有些不对劲。

sentences.en: The ATF suspected Olutosin might possibly be a straw purchaser, someone buying guns for someone else.
sentences.zh: 烟酒枪炮及爆裂物管理局怀疑奥卢托辛可能是个代购枪支的人，即替他人买枪的人。

sentences.en: But Tom Gibbon says police also considered more sinister motives.
sentences.zh: 但汤姆·吉本斯表示，警方也考虑了更险恶的动机。

sentences.en: Having three identical weapons, if a person's going to do something harmful or commit a mass
sentences.zh: 拥有三把相同的武器，如果一个人打算做有害的事情或制造大规模

sentences.en: casualty event, having three identical firearms has the advantage of being able to use the
sentences.zh: 伤亡事件，拥有三把相同的枪支的好处在于能够使用

sentences.en: identical ammunition, to use the exact same magazines with that ammunition, no matter
sentences.zh: 相同的弹药，无论使用哪一把枪都可以使用

sentences.en: which of the guns you're using.
sentences.zh: 完全相同的弹匣和弹药。

sentences.en: And of course, buying low-cost multiple weapons allows you to
sentences.zh: 当然，购买多个低成本的武器可以让你

sentences.en: have multiple weapons available at a single time.
sentences.zh: 在同一时间拥有多把武器可用。

sentences.en: The ATF quickly learned that Olutosen was a student
sentences.zh: 烟酒枪炮及爆裂物管理局很快得知奥卢托森是

sentences.en: at Southern Illinois University.
sentences.zh: 南伊利诺伊大学的一名学生。

sentences.en: The ATF contacted the local police department
sentences.zh: 烟酒枪炮及爆裂物管理局联系了当地警察局

sentences.en: and they began to look into it.
sentences.zh: 他们开始对此展开调查。

sentences.en: According to documents later filed in court,
sentences.zh: 根据后来提交给法院的文件，

sentences.en: the ATF agent also called campus police detective
sentences.zh: 烟酒枪炮及爆裂物管理局特工还打电话给校园警察侦探

sentences.en: Rick Weisenborn.
sentences.zh: 里克·维森博恩。

sentences.en: The ATF gave the detective a heads up
sentences.zh: 烟酒枪炮及爆裂物管理局向这位侦探通报了

sentences.en: that Olitosan had ordered weapons over the internet.
sentences.zh: 奥利托森在网上订购了武器的情况。

sentences.en: Rick Weisenborn wrote a memo to his colleagues
sentences.zh: 里克·维森博恩给他的同事写了一份备忘录

sentences.en: that advised them to use caution
sentences.zh: 建议他们在遇到这名年轻男子时

sentences.en: if they encountered the young man.
sentences.zh: 务必保持谨慎。

sentences.en: Two days later, a police officer
sentences.zh: 两天后，一名正在进行

sentences.en: on a routine campus patrol
sentences.zh: 日常校园巡逻的警官

sentences.en: came across an unattended car.
sentences.zh: 偶然发现了一辆无人看管的汽车。

sentences.en: He alerted Rick Weissenborn, who went to investigate.
sentences.zh: 他提醒了里克·维森博恩，后者随即前往调查。

sentences.en: Police traced the license plate to Olotosin Odawale.
sentences.zh: 警方通过车牌查到了奥洛托辛·奥达瓦莱。

sentences.en: His car was discovered, parked in a very conspicuous,
sentences.zh: 他的车被发现停在一个非常显眼、

sentences.en: a very unusual no-parking area at the university here in Edwardsville.
sentences.zh: 非常不寻常的、位于爱德华兹维尔大学的禁停区域。

sentences.en: Police monitored the vehicle to see if anyone approached it.
sentences.zh: 警方监控这辆车，看是否有人靠近。

sentences.en: For two days, Rick Weissenborn drove past the car himself.
sentences.zh: 连续两天，里克·维森博恩自己开车经过这辆车。

sentences.en: No one showed up.
sentences.zh: 没有人出现。

sentences.en: The detective notified his supervisor.
sentences.zh: 这位侦探通知了他的上司。

sentences.en: Campus police were authorized to tow a vehicle
sentences.zh: 校园警察有权拖走

sentences.en: that had been left unattended for more than 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 无人看管超过24小时的车辆。

sentences.en: So when his car was being towed,
sentences.zh: 因此，当他的车被拖走时，

sentences.en: it's the police department policy that the car is inventoried.
sentences.zh: 警察局的政策是对车辆进行清点。

sentences.en: They take an inventory of the contents,
sentences.zh: 他们对车内的物品进行盘点，

sentences.en: and they found, you know, visible in the car, a note.
sentences.zh: 他们发现，你知道的，车里显眼处放着一张便条。

sentences.en: It was protruding from underneath the center console.
sentences.zh: 它从中央控制台下方露出来。

sentences.en: It had writing on both sides.
sentences.zh: 两面都写了字。

sentences.en: On one side were what seemed like rap lyrics.
sentences.zh: 一面看起来像是说唱歌词。

sentences.en: Turn the page over, and there were more lyrics.
sentences.zh: 翻过那一页，还有更多的歌词。

sentences.en: Tom says they read like this.
sentences.zh: 汤姆说它们读起来是这样的。

sentences.en: And you may have to bleep some of this out.
sentences.zh: 你可能得把其中一些消音。

sentences.en: I lead, she a follower.
sentences.zh: 我主导，她顺从。

sentences.en: I'm single and not with her,
sentences.zh: 我单身且与她无关，

sentences.en: but she got a throat deeper than a sword swallower.
sentences.zh: 但她的喉咙深得像个吞剑的人。

sentences.en: Further down on the page was more writing.
sentences.zh: 页面下方还有更多的字。

sentences.en: Tom says these were not lyrics.
sentences.zh: 汤姆说这些不是歌词。

sentences.en: Send $2 to, and then it's a PayPal account, if the money doesn't reach $50,000 in the next seven days,
sentences.zh: 汇2美元到，然后是一个PayPal账户，如果这笔钱在未来七天内没有达到50,000美元，

sentences.en: then a murderous rampage similar to the Virginia Tech shooting will occur at another highly populated university, and then in all capital letters, this is not a joke.
sentences.zh: 那么将在另一所人口密集的大学发生类似弗吉尼亚理工大学枪击案的血腥大屠杀，然后全部是大写字母，这不是一个玩笑。

sentences.en: Police didn't take it as one.
sentences.zh: 警方可不认为这是个玩笑。

sentences.en: Detective Rick Weissenborn took photos of the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 侦探里克·维森博恩给这辆车拍了照。

sentences.en: While snapping pictures of the back seat,
sentences.zh: 在拍摄后座照片时，

sentences.en: he noticed release straps and pulled them to lower the seat backs.
sentences.zh: 他注意到了释放带并拉动它们以放低座椅靠背。

sentences.en: He found a wad of clothing.
sentences.zh: 他发现了一团衣物。

sentences.en: There was a long-sleeved shirt, a short-sleeved shirt,
sentences.zh: 里面有一件长袖衬衫、一件短袖衬衫，

sentences.en: and a knit cap with a ski mask.
sentences.zh: 以及一顶带有滑雪面罩的针织帽。

sentences.en: The detective seized all of it.
sentences.zh: 侦探把这些全查获了。

sentences.en: Officers also found six rounds of .25-caliber ammunition in the car.
sentences.zh: 警员还在车里发现了六发.25口径弹药。

sentences.en: They felt they needed to act faSt.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得必须迅速采取行动。

sentences.en: It was pretty early in the morning,
sentences.zh: 那是清晨挺早的时候，

sentences.en: I remember, and I had just gotten up, gotten out of the shower.
sentences.zh: 我记得，我才刚起床、刚洗完澡。

sentences.en: This is Thomas Phillips III.
sentences.zh: 这是托马斯·菲利普斯三世。

sentences.en: He was Olitosan Odewale's roommate that summer.
sentences.zh: 那年夏天他是奥利托森·奥德瓦莱的室友。

sentences.en: He remembers a loud pounding on the door.
sentences.zh: 他记得门外传出一阵剧烈的砸门声。

sentences.en: And there was about eight police officers standing there.
sentences.zh: 大约有八名警员站在那里。

sentences.en: Thomas was asked to step out of the room.
sentences.zh: 托马斯被要求离开房间。

sentences.en: Police told Olitosan he was under arreSt.
sentences.zh: 警察告诉奥利托森他被捕了。

sentences.en: Olitosan was wearing basketball shorts and a tank top.
sentences.zh: 奥利托森穿着篮球短裤和一件背心。

sentences.en: He didn't have shoes on.
sentences.zh: 他没穿鞋。

sentences.en: They cuffed him, they had his hands behind his back,
sentences.zh: 他们给他戴上手铐，双手反剪在背后，

sentences.en: and he didn't look my way when he came out,
sentences.zh: 他出来时没有朝我这边看，

sentences.en: but I don't also think that he saw where I was sitting
sentences.zh: 但我也觉得他没看到我坐在哪儿，

sentences.en: because I was sitting off to the side on the stairs.
sentences.zh: 因为我当时坐在楼梯的一侧。

sentences.en: But they took him out the long way toward the back

sentences.zh: 先是去了英国，然后是尼日利亚。

sentences.en: Now, that might not seem the best move for an aspiring rap artist,
sentences.zh: 现在看来，这对于一个怀揣说唱梦想的人来说可能不是最好的决定，

sentences.en: but Tosin says his Nigerian boarding school was full of kids like him.
sentences.zh: 但托辛说，他的尼日利亚寄宿学校里到处都是和他一样的小孩。

sentences.en: So I was surrounded around a lot of people from New Jersey, New York, Atlanta, California, and London.
sentences.zh: 所以我身边围满了来自新泽西、纽约、亚特兰大、加利福尼亚和伦敦的人。

sentences.en: And a lot of them made music.
sentences.zh: 他们当中有很多人都做音乐。

sentences.en: And so a lot of what we used to do in Nigeria when we were in the dorms is that we would write rap music.
sentences.zh: 所以在尼日利亚时，我们在宿舍里经常做的一件事就是写说唱音乐。

sentences.en: And I think it was in Nigeria where I really got, I guess, like creative and better because we were able to just really lock in.
sentences.zh: 我想正是在尼日利亚，我变得真正有创造力并且有所进步，因为我们能够真正地全神贯注。

sentences.en: You know, in America, I was only with my friends at school seven hours a day.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在美国，我一天只有七个小时和学校的朋友们在一起。

sentences.en: Nigeria, I'm with you 24 hours a day for three months.
sentences.zh: 而在尼日利亚，我和你们连续三个月、一天24小时都在一起。

sentences.en: You know, and so it was, yeah, it was where I guess I fell in love with it more was when I was in Africa.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，所以，是的，我可以说，我更深刻地爱上说唱正是在我在非洲的那段时光。

sentences.en: It was in Nigeria that Tosin made his public debut as a rapper.
sentences.zh: 正是在尼日利亚，托辛作为说唱歌手完成了他的公开首秀。

sentences.en: In church.
sentences.zh: 在教堂里。

sentences.en: He went to a Christian school, and each Sunday, the entire school went to church.
sentences.zh: 他上的是一所基督教学校，每周日，全校师生都会去教堂。

sentences.en: It was a huge church.
sentences.zh: 那是一个巨大的教堂。

sentences.en: Sometimes they would allow students from the church to either sing songs on stage or do little performances.
sentences.zh: 有时他们会允许教堂的学生在舞台上唱歌或进行小型表演。

sentences.en: We decided to do a rap.
sentences.zh: 我们决定表演一段说唱。

sentences.en: A Christian rap in front of the entire congregation.
sentences.zh: 在全体会众面前表演一段基督教说唱。

sentences.en: 2,500 people.
sentences.zh: 足足有两千五百人。

sentences.en: When Tosin tells the story, you can hear his happiness just remembering that moment.
sentences.zh: 当托辛讲述这段经历时，光是回忆起那个时刻，你就能感受到他的喜悦。

sentences.en: I run on stage with the mic and everybody's like, ah!
sentences.zh: 我拿着话筒冲上舞台，大家都在喊：“啊！”

sentences.en: And everybody's like praising you.
sentences.zh: 所有人都在为你欢呼。

sentences.en: And then I started rapping.
sentences.zh: 然后我开始说唱。

sentences.en: Nobody heard what I said, but they were going crazy.
sentences.zh: 根本没人听清我唱了什么，但他们都疯狂了。

sentences.en: And it was like, this is a church.
sentences.zh: 而且这还是在教堂里。

sentences.en: It really fed my ego.
sentences.zh: 这真的极大地满足了我的虚荣心。

sentences.en: Like, oh man, people love me.
sentences.zh: 就像是，天哪，人们爱我。

sentences.en: The people love me, you know, like whatever, it's just church.
sentences.zh: 人们爱我，你知道的，管他呢，这可是教堂啊。

sentences.en: But that was really, really, I guess, a confidence builder
sentences.zh: 但那确实，真的，可以说是极大地建立起了我的自信，

sentences.en: as far as, like, okay, you can take your raps away from just your circle of friends
sentences.zh: 就好像，好吧，你可以把你的说唱带出你的朋友圈子，

sentences.en: and actually, like, say them to the public.
sentences.zh: 并真正地在公众面前表演出来。

sentences.en: When Tosin was in his last year of high school in Nigeria,
sentences.zh: 当托辛在尼日利亚读高中的最后一年时，

sentences.en: he applied to go to college in the United States.
sentences.zh: 他申请去美国的大学深造。

sentences.en: He had only one school in mind, Southern Illinois University.
sentences.zh: 他心里只有一所学校，那就是南伊利诺伊大学。

sentences.en: It appealed to him because it was close to St. Louis,
sentences.zh: 吸引他的原因是它离圣路易斯很近，

sentences.en: close to his family, his friends, his home.
sentences.zh: 离他的家人、朋友和家很近。

sentences.en: He was accepted.
sentences.zh: 他被录取了。

sentences.en: In the fall of 2005, he started his freshman year.
sentences.zh: 在2005年秋天，他开始了大学新生生活。

sentences.en: Tosin describes it as a pretty typical introduction to college life,
sentences.zh: 托辛形容这是一次相当典型的大学生活初体验，

sentences.en: classes, parties, students always moving together in huge groups.
sentences.zh: 上课、派对，学生们总是成群结队地活动。

sentences.en: In the spring, Tosin decided to join a fraternity.
sentences.zh: 到了春季，托辛决定加入一个兄弟会。

sentences.en: He chose and was accepted by Iota Phi Theta, an historically African-American frat.
sentences.zh: 他选择了并被“Iota Phi Theta”兄弟会接纳，这是一个有着悠久历史的非裔美国人兄弟会。

sentences.en: Thomas Phillips met Tosin through the fraternity.
sentences.zh: 托马斯·菲利普斯通过兄弟会认识了托辛。

sentences.en: He remembers his first glimpse of him because Tosin stood out.
sentences.zh: 他依然记得自己对托辛的第一印象，因为托辛太显眼了。

sentences.en: He was a little bitty kid wearing a gigantic hoodie and the biggest headphones.
sentences.zh: 他是个身材瘦小的小不点，穿着一件巨大的连帽衫，戴着超大的耳机。

sentences.en: Vintage headphones.
sentences.zh: 复古耳机。

sentences.en: So do you know, like, back in, like, the 80s when they first had, like, the home stereo headphones
sentences.zh: 所以你知道的，就像在80年代左右，当他们刚推出那种家用立体声耳机时，

sentences.en: that were, like, the big gigantic cushion pairs with the metal braces on the sides?
sentences.zh: 就是那种带有金属支架、配有巨大厚实耳垫的耳机？

sentences.en: Like, ones you would necessarily wear out in public.
sentences.zh: 那种你通常不会戴着出门上街的耳机。

sentences.en: You might listen to, like, these headphones in the comfort of your own home.
sentences.zh: 你可能只会在自己家里舒适的环境中听听这种耳机。

sentences.en: But something about those headphones and him being as small as he was then kind of stuck out to me.
sentences.zh: 但不知为什么，那副耳机和他当时娇小的身材让我印象深刻。

sentences.en: So as it turned out, he was really big into music, especially rap music.
sentences.zh: 后来证明，他确实非常痴迷于音乐，尤其是说唱音乐。

sentences.en: And that was the best pair of headphones he could find at the time that gave him the best sound quality.
sentences.zh: 那是他当时能找到的、音质最好的耳机。

sentences.en: The two became good friends.
sentences.zh: 两人成了好朋友。

sentences.en: Thomas S.
sentences.zh: 托马斯说道，

sentences.en: Tosin was big-hearted.
sentences.zh: 托辛心地善良。

sentences.en: He looked out for people.
sentences.zh: 他很照顾别人。

sentences.en: He often asked fraternity brothers to help him check up on the homeless in the area.
sentences.zh: 他经常请兄弟会的兄弟们帮他去探望当地的无家可归者。

sentences.en: He organized campus events, including a speech by former Black Panther, Bobby Seale.
sentences.zh: 他组织校园活动，包括邀请前黑豹党成员鲍比·西尔进行演讲。

sentences.en: And he drew people together with his music.
sentences.zh: 他还用音乐将人们聚集在一起。

sentences.en: It was music that made him such a good fit for the fraternity.
sentences.zh: 正是音乐让他如此契合这个兄弟会。

sentences.en: At the time, most of us in the fraternity at least had some kind of musical talent.
sentences.zh: 当时，我们兄弟会的大多数人至少都有些音乐才华。

sentences.en: Like, if you didn't play an instrument, you sung.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果你不玩乐器，你就会唱歌。

sentences.en: If you couldn't sing, you rapped.
sentences.zh: 如果你不会唱歌，你就会说唱。

sentences.en: If you couldn't do any of the three, which I can't, then you were either a producer or a mixer.
sentences.zh: 如果你这三样都不会（比如我），那你就会成为一名制作人或混音师。

sentences.en: Tosin, of course, rapped.
sentences.zh: 托辛当然是负责说唱。

sentences.en: Thomas produced.
sentences.zh: 托马斯负责制作。

sentences.en: They started talking about making it big.
sentences.zh: 他们开始谈论要闯出一片天地。

sentences.en: As Thomas describes those days to me,
sentences.zh: 当托马斯向我描述那些日子时，

sentences.en: he says it's important to understand one thing about Tosin.
sentences.zh: 他说有一点关于托辛的特质是很重要的，必须理解。

sentences.en: His music meant everything to him, but it wasn't him.
sentences.zh: 他的音乐对他来说意味着一切，但音乐并不代表他本人。

sentences.en: So one of the things that I did notice was that
sentences.zh: 所以，我注意到的一件事是，

sentences.en: as much as Tosin, his personality,
sentences.zh: 尽管托辛的性格，他真正的个性

sentences.en: his actual personality came through in his actions,
sentences.zh: 会在他的行动中流露出来，

sentences.en: his music was entirely different.
sentences.zh: 但他的音乐却完全是另一回事。

sentences.en: Tosin did relish songs with violent and misogynistic lyrics,
sentences.zh: 托辛确实很喜欢那些充满暴力和厌女歌词的歌曲，

sentences.en: but that didn't mean that he was a violent or misogynistic person.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着他是一个崇尚暴力或厌女的人。

sentences.en: One of his favorite groups at the time was 3-6 Mafia.
sentences.zh: 他当时最喜欢的组合之一是3-6黑手党。

sentences.en: I'm not sure if you're familiar with them or not,
sentences.zh: 我不知道你是否熟悉他们，

sentences.en: but a lot of their music at the time was pretty much
sentences.zh: 但他们当时的大多数音乐基本上就是

sentences.en: the version of rock and roll, like sex and drugs kind of deal.
sentences.zh: 摇滚乐的翻版，充满了诸如性与毒品之类的题材。

sentences.en: Eventually, Thomas and Tosin decided to move in together.
sentences.zh: 最终，托马斯和托辛决定合租。

sentences.en: They found a ratty two-bedroom apartment not far from campus.
sentences.zh: 他们在离校园不远的地方找到了一间破旧的两居室公寓。

sentences.en: Thomas says it was perfect.
sentences.zh: 托马斯说这简直完美。

sentences.en: Meaning, like, if you want to rap about, you know, how hard your life is
sentences.zh: 意思是，如果你想写歌去说唱，你知道的，关于你的生活有多艰难，

sentences.en: and how, you know, there's a lot of crime in your area,
sentences.zh: 以及你知道的，你所在的地区犯罪率有多高，

sentences.en: and you want to rap about what's real,
sentences.zh: 并且你想唱出真实的现实，

sentences.en: like, this is the place that you can actually do it,
sentences.zh: 那么，这绝对是个你可以付诸实践的地方，

sentences.en: and it feels authentic because you're not actually recording this
sentences.zh: 而且感觉非常真实，因为你并不是在

sentences.en: from, you know, a nice apartment in St. Louis someplace.
sentences.zh: 圣路易斯的某个豪华公寓里录音。

sentences.en: You're not recording this in a hotel or in a penthouse
sentences.zh: 你不是在酒店、顶层公寓

sentences.en: or a nice recording studio.
sentences.zh: 或豪华录音室里录音。

sentences.en: We're in the basement.
sentences.zh: 我们在地下室里。

sentences.en: There are roaches everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是蟑螂，

sentences.en: and we were recording this in a closet.
sentences.zh: 我们是在一个壁橱里录音的。

sentences.en: You know, because our studio was in the living room.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，因为我们的录音室就在起居室里。

sentences.en: There was a closet in the living room, which was for coats.
sentences.zh: 起居室里有个壁橱，原本是用来挂外套的。

sentences.en: Like, you know, when you have guests come, you take their coats,
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道的，当你有客人来时，你拿走他们的外套，

sentences.en: you put them in a closet.
sentences.zh: 把它们放进壁橱里。

sentences.en: We turned that closet into a studio booth.
sentences.zh: 我们把那个壁橱改造成了一个录音棚小隔间。

sentences.en: So our microphone was in there.
sentences.zh: 所以我们的麦克风就在里面。

sentences.en: We put foam all over the walls to kind of soundproof it,
sentences.zh: 我们在墙上贴满了泡沫隔音棉来进行隔音，

sentences.en: and that was the studio booth.
sentences.zh: 那就是我们的录音小隔间。

sentences.en: The apartment became a wrap salon, or as Tosin puts it, an artist's den.
sentences.zh: 这间公寓成了说唱沙龙，或者用托辛的话来说，是一个艺术家的巢穴。

sentences.en: And so that was how it was.
sentences.zh: 当时的情况就是这样。

sentences.en: It was pieces of paper and notebooks everywhere in the living room,
sentences.zh: 起居室里到处都是纸片和笔记本，

sentences.en: a couch, a TV, a computer, studio equipment, microphone, keyboard, and that was our artist
sentences.zh: 一张沙发、一台电视、一台电脑、录音设备、麦克风、键盘，这就是我们的艺术

sentences.en: space.
sentences.zh: 空间。

sentences.en: They were experimenting, writing, rewriting, trying to compose songs that worked.
sentences.zh: 他们在不断试验、写作、重写，试图创作出完美的歌曲。

sentences.en: They played a
sentences.zh: 他们在校园里

sentences.en: couple of gigs on campus.
sentences.zh: 演出过好几场。

sentences.en: Sometimes they handed out free CDs to get their name out.
sentences.zh: 有时他们会分发免费CD来打响名气。

sentences.en: But money was
sentences.zh: 但资金

sentences.en: always tight, and they needed better equipment.
sentences.zh: 总是很紧张，他们需要更好的设备。

sentences.en: Tosin views himself as an entrepreneur.
sentences.zh: 托辛认为自己是一个创业者。

sentences.en: He proudly
sentences.zh: 他自豪地

sentences.en: points out that he came from a family of self-starters.
sentences.zh: 指出自己出身于一个白手起家的家庭。

sentences.en: So, he says, he started looking
sentences.zh: 所以，他说，他开始寻找

sentences.en: for opportunities to make some extra cash.
sentences.zh: 赚取外快的机会。

sentences.en: He landed on an idea, one that, in retrospect,
sentences.zh: 他想到了一个主意，现在回想起来，

sentences.en: might not have been the beSt. It involved the internet and guns.
sentences.zh: 这个主意可能并不是最明智的。它涉及互联网和枪支。

sentences.en: And so I was thinking, okay, you know, maybe this could be like a beginner business where I could
sentences.zh: 所以当时我在想，好吧，你知道的，也许这可以作为一项初级生意，我在网上向制造商

sentences.en: buy these guns very cheap from the manufacturers online, have them shipped to a local dealer,
sentences.zh: 以非常便宜的价格购买这些枪支，然后把它们运给当地的枪械经销商，

sentences.en: and then resell them for retail price and make a little bit of money.
sentences.zh: 然后以零售价转售，赚取一点利润。

sentences.en: And we could use this money and buy all the equipment, studio equipment that we could dream of.
sentences.zh: 我们可以用这笔钱买下所有梦寐以求的设备，录音室设备。

sentences.en: Because that was one thing that was kind of harming us our first six or seven months.
sentences.zh: 因为这是在头六七个月里有点拖我们后腿的事情。

sentences.en: The equipment that we were recording music with was very bad.
sentences.zh: 我们用来录制音乐的设备非常糟糕。

sentences.en: It was just, you know, the final songs, there'd be a lot of static.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就是最终的歌曲里会有很多杂音。

sentences.en: And we just knew we needed better equipment.
sentences.zh: 我们只知道我们需要更好的设备。

sentences.en: What Tosin was thinking of is called dropshipping.
sentences.zh: 托辛想到的是一种叫做代发货的模式。

sentences.en: It's used all the time in online sales.
sentences.zh: 它在网上销售中一直被广泛使用。

sentences.en: When you buy a product online from a retailer, that product isn't necessarily sitting in the retailer's warehouse.
sentences.zh: 当你从零售商那里在线购买产品时，该产品不一定放在零售商的仓库里。

sentences.en: Sometimes the retailer has to order it from a wholesaler.
sentences.zh: 有时零售商必须从批发商那里订购。

sentences.en: You've paid for a product the retailer doesn't physically possess.
sentences.zh: 你购买了一个零售商实际并不拥有的产品。

sentences.en: Tosin thought he could adapt this model to the online gun market.
sentences.zh: 托辛认为他可以将这种模式应用到在线枪支市场。

sentences.en: Buy guns wholesale and then mark up the price.
sentences.zh: 批发购买枪支然后加价出售。

sentences.en: The basic business idea was buy low, sell high, period.
sentences.zh: 基本的商业理念就是低买高卖，就这样。

sentences.en: Tosin advertised guns for sale online.
sentences.zh: 托辛在网上发布了出售枪支的广告。

sentences.en: Once people bought them, he ordered the guns from the wholesaler.
sentences.zh: 一旦人们购买了，他就从批发商那里订购枪支。

sentences.en: But with gun sales, there's a catch.
sentences.zh: 但对于枪支销售来说，有一个问题。

sentences.en: Guns bought wholesale must go through a licensed gun dealer
sentences.zh: 批发购买的枪支必须通过持牌枪支经销商

sentences.en: before they can pass on to a buyer.
sentences.zh: 才能转交给买家。

sentences.en: That didn't worry Tosin.
sentences.zh: 托辛并不担心这一点。

sentences.en: He wasn't doing anything illegal.
sentences.zh: 他没有做任何违法的事情。

sentences.en: He contacted a local gun dealer and asked him to put through the transaction.
sentences.zh: 他联系了一位当地的枪支经销商，请他代为处理这笔交易。

sentences.en: And so that was what I was doing.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时做的就是这个。

sentences.en: I never took possession of those guns.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有真正拥有过那些枪支。

sentences.en: I never intended to.
sentences.zh: 我从来没打算过。

sentences.en: I never did.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有这样做过。

sentences.en: Tosin agrees that he called the gun dealer repeatedly to ask about the weapons.
sentences.zh: 托辛承认他曾多次打电话给枪支经销商询问武器的事。

sentences.en: But that's because, he says, he had already accepted money from buyers and needed to complete the transaction.
sentences.zh: 但他表示，那是因为他已经收了买家的钱，需要完成交易。

sentences.en: So, to recap, we have a young man with big dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 所以，总结一下，我们有一个心怀大志的年轻人。

sentences.en: He's got a budding career as a rapper, an active social life, and a commitment to community service.
sentences.zh: 他有着刚刚起步的说唱歌手生涯、活跃的社交生活，并且热心社区服务。

sentences.en: He's buying guns, but only, he says, to sell them and make a little extra cash for music equipment.
sentences.zh: 他在买枪，但他表示，这么做只是为了卖掉它们，赚点外快来买音乐设备。

sentences.en: This is not the picture of a would-be terroriSt.
sentences.zh: 这完全不是一个潜在恐怖分子的形象。

sentences.en: But that brings us to that piece of paper that police found in Tosin's car.
sentences.zh: 但这把我们带到了警察在托辛车里发现的那张纸上。

sentences.en: As state's attorney Tom Gibbons put it,
sentences.zh: 正如州检察官汤姆·吉本斯所说，

sentences.en: They found, you know, visible in the car, a note.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们在车里发现了显眼的一张便条。

sentences.en: It had music lyrics on one side, but a threat on the other.
sentences.zh: 它的一面写着歌词，另一面则写着威胁。

sentences.en: Send $2 to, and then it's a PayPal account.
sentences.zh: 将2美元发送至，然后是一个贝宝账户。

sentences.en: If the money doesn't reach $50,000 in the next seven days,
sentences.zh: 如果这笔钱在未来七天内没有达到50,000美元，

sentences.en: then a murderous rampage, similar to the Virginia Tech shooting,
sentences.zh: 那么类似于弗吉尼亚理工大学枪击案的血腥暴行

sentences.en: will occur at another highly populated university,
sentences.zh: 将在另一个人口稠密的高校发生，

sentences.en: And then in all capital letters, this is not a joke.
sentences.zh: 接着全部是大写字母，这不是一个笑话。

sentences.en: It would be hard to explain away a note like this,
sentences.zh: 很难为这样一张纸条辩解，

sentences.en: demanding ransom, threatening a campus massacre.
sentences.zh: 它要求勒索赎金，并威胁要对校园进行大屠杀。

sentences.en: But Tosin says the problem lies in one word, note.
sentences.zh: 但托辛说，问题出在便条这个词上。

sentences.en: What the police found, he insists, was not a note.
sentences.zh: 他坚称，警察发现的根本不是什么便条。

sentences.en: It was scribbled ideas for a rap song.
sentences.zh: 那是为一首说唱歌曲涂鸦的创意。

sentences.en: This is how Tosin says it all unfolded.
sentences.zh: 这就是托辛所说的事情发展的经过。

sentences.en: It began as an idea one night in the artist's den.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于一天晚上在艺术家书房里的一个灵感。

sentences.en: Tosin had just finished watching the TV show Law & Order.
sentences.zh: 托辛刚刚看完电视剧《法律与秩序》。

sentences.en: The episode was about some bloggers who live-streamed their home on social media.
sentences.zh: 那一集讲的是一些博主在社交媒体上直播他们的日常生活。

sentences.en: So, it's me, Willow, again.
sentences.zh: 所以，我是威洛，又见面了。

sentences.en: A lot of you commented on the fight that Holden and I had in yesterday's video.
sentences.zh: 你们很多人在昨天视频里霍尔顿和我的争吵下面留言了。

sentences.en: And so, the way the episode started off,
sentences.zh: 所以，这一集的开头是这样的，

sentences.en: while they were live-streaming, just hanging out,
sentences.zh: 当他们在直播、闲聊时，

sentences.en: masked men kicking the door.
sentences.zh: 蒙面男子踢开门。

sentences.en: kidnap the girl, beat up her boyfriend, and then later they get back on her online page
sentences.zh: 绑架了女孩，痛殴了她的男友，后来他们又回到了她的网页上

sentences.en: and start a ransom.
sentences.zh: 并开始勒索赎金。

sentences.en: Tosin was fascinated by the episode.
sentences.zh: 托辛对这一集着迷了。

sentences.en: He loved the way it played with viewers.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢它玩弄观众心理的方式。

sentences.en: All the way through, it kept people guessing.
sentences.zh: 自始至终，它都让人们一直在猜想。

sentences.en: Were they watching an actual kidnapping take place online?
sentences.zh: 他们是在观看网上发生的实际绑架案吗？

sentences.en: Were they watching performance art?
sentences.zh: 他们是在看行为艺术吗？

sentences.en: Tosin thought the premise might make a cool spoken introduction to a rap song.
sentences.zh: 托辛认为这个前提可以作为说唱歌曲的酷炫旁白开场。

sentences.en: And so that was where the idea, I was trying to figure out something, I tried to figure out something that would be real to what's actually in life.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是那个想法，我当时在琢磨一些事情，我试图弄出一个贴近现实生活的东西。

sentences.en: Like there is PayPal and there is YouTube and there is et cetera, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 就像有贝宝、有优兔等等等等。

sentences.en: And so it was kind of like a copy of that, but it's something that wasn't as fake as that, something that was actually real.
sentences.zh: 所以这有点像是那种东西的翻版，但它不是那么虚假，而是真正真实的东西。

sentences.en: Sometimes rap songs start this way, with introductions that set a scene with lyrics that don't rhyme.
sentences.zh: 有时候说唱歌曲就是以这种方式开场的，用不押韵的歌词来设定场景的引子。

sentences.en: That, says Tosin's friend Thomas, is what they were playing with.
sentences.zh: 托辛的朋友托马斯说，这就是他们当时在琢磨的东西。

sentences.en: You heard the introduction to Nas' It Was Written?
sentences.zh: 你听过纳斯的《It Was Written》的开场白吗？

sentences.en: I haven't.
sentences.zh: 我没听过。

sentences.en: How does it go?
sentences.zh: 那是怎么样的？

sentences.en: It starts off with two slaves in the field.
sentences.zh: 它一开始是地里的两个奴隶。

sentences.en: And this is set back in, you know, the slavery days.
sentences.zh: 背景设定在，你知道的，奴隶制时期。

sentences.en: So, in American history.
sentences.zh: 也就是美国历史上。

sentences.en: So what happens is that the two slaves hear the overseer coming
sentences.zh: 所以发生的事情是，两个奴隶听到监工走近，

sentences.en: and they decide to stage a revolt right at that point.
sentences.zh: 他们决定就在那一刻发动起义。

sentences.en: Damn you, master.
sentences.zh: 去你的，主人。

sentences.en: You ain't my master, man.
sentences.zh: 你才不是我的主人，伙计。

sentences.en: And you hear the slaves beating the master down.
sentences.zh: 然后你听到奴隶们痛打主人。

sentences.en: And then you hear the slaves being dragged away once the revolt's pretty much quelled at that point.
sentences.zh: 一旦起义基本被平息，你就会听到奴隶被拖走的声音。

sentences.en: So it's an introduction that draws you in.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个引人入胜的开场。

sentences.en: And you hear this violent introduction.
sentences.zh: 你听到了这个暴力的开场白。

sentences.en: And then the lead song comes on.
sentences.zh: 然后主打歌就播放了。

sentences.en: Tosin wondered whether the demand for a ransom
sentences.zh: 托辛琢磨着索要赎金的要求

sentences.en: and the threat of a campus shooting could make for a good intro.
sentences.zh: 以及校园枪击的威胁是否能构成一个好的引子。

sentences.en: The friends played with the idea and tried out a few things.
sentences.zh: 朋友们琢磨着这个想法，并尝试了一些不同的东西。

sentences.en: They wrote some lyrics on a piece of paper.
sentences.zh: 他们在纸上写了一些歌词。

sentences.en: They even made a lyric video where the words of a song scroll on the screen.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至制作了一个歌词视频，歌词在屏幕上滚动。

sentences.en: Tosin felt it didn't work.
sentences.zh: 托辛觉得这行不通。

sentences.en: But some of the lines he wrote on the other side of the paper
sentences.zh: 但他在纸的另一面写下的一些行

sentences.en: did eventually become a song.
sentences.zh: 最终确实变成了一首歌。

sentences.en: It was called Pop It, Mommy, Pop It.
sentences.zh: 它叫做《Pop It, Mommy, Pop It》。

sentences.en: It's like a club song.
sentences.zh: 这就像是一首夜店歌曲。

sentences.en: It's about girls dancing in a club.
sentences.zh: 它讲的是女孩在夜店里跳舞。

sentences.en: I wrote it complete from beginning to end.
sentences.zh: 我从头到尾完整地写了下来。

sentences.en: The lyrics on the other side of the paper were the ones that Tosin discarded.
sentences.zh: 纸另一面的歌词是被托辛丢弃的那部分。

sentences.en: It was the reference to the Virginia Tech shootings, the threat of a mass killing.
sentences.zh: 那是关于弗吉尼亚理工大学枪击案的引用，是对群体谋杀的威胁。

sentences.en: When Tosin decided to move back to campus sometime later,
sentences.zh: 后来当托辛决定搬回校园时，

sentences.en: he threw all his notebooks and paper and clothes into his car to move them to a dorm.
sentences.zh: 他把所有的笔记本、纸张和衣服都扔进车里，准备搬到宿舍去。

sentences.en: One sheet of paper slipped under the center console.
sentences.zh: 有一张纸滑到了中控台下面。

sentences.en: It was the sheet police would later find in his car.
sentences.zh: 这就是警察后来在他的车里发现的那张纸。

sentences.en: Tosin says the police simply had him wrong.
sentences.zh: 托辛说警察完全搞错了。

sentences.en: He wasn't a terrorist in the making.
sentences.zh: 他不是一个正在成长的恐怖分子。

sentences.en: He was a student, a musician, a budding entrepreneur.
sentences.zh: 他是一个学生、音乐家、初露头角的创业者。

sentences.en: He left his car on a campus side road for a simple reason.
sentences.zh: 他把车停在校园旁边的路上原因很简单。

sentences.en: He'd run out of gas.
sentences.zh: 他的车没油了。

sentences.en: He says he was going to get more fuel when he got paid at the end of the week.
sentences.zh: 他说他打算在周末拿到工资后再去加满油。

sentences.en: And that loaded gun in his dorm?
sentences.zh: 至于他宿舍里那把上膛的枪呢？

sentences.en: Tosin agrees he shouldn't have had the gun in campus housing.
sentences.zh: 托辛承认他不该把枪带进学生宿舍。

sentences.en: But he insists it was an innocent mistake.
sentences.zh: 但他坚称这是一个无心的错误。

sentences.en: He'd legally registered the weapon and thought that that made it okay to have it with him on campus.
sentences.zh: 他合法登记了这把武器，并认为这意味着随身把它带在校园里是可以的。

sentences.en: Both Tosin and his friend Thomas say owning guns was not unusual in their part of the MidweSt.
sentences.zh: 托辛和他的朋友托马斯都说，在他们那个中西部地区拥有枪支并不罕见。

sentences.en: It just wasn't a big deal.
sentences.zh: 这根本算不上什么大事。

sentences.en: One of the things that I kind of want to make sure that everybody's clear on is that
sentences.zh: 我特别想确保每个人都清楚的一点是，

sentences.en: down in southern Illinois and St. Louis, Missouri area and all that,
sentences.zh: 在伊利诺伊州南部和密苏里州圣路易斯地区以及所有这些地方，

sentences.en: there was a pretty big gun culture.
sentences.zh: 有着相当浓厚的枪支文化。

sentences.en: So when we moved off campus, one of the things that he mentioned that he wanted to do
sentences.zh: 所以当我们搬出校园时，他提到想要做的一件事

sentences.en: and that we both ended up doing was applying for our FOID cards,
sentences.zh: 以及我们最后都做了的一件事就是申请我们的FOID卡，

sentences.en: the firearm identification that Illinois has.
sentences.zh: 也就是伊利诺伊州的枪支识别证。

sentences.en: You have to get an ID to own or carry a firearm.
sentences.zh: 你必须获得身份证才能拥有或携带枪支。

sentences.en: Thomas and Tosin both say they had no idea the police were poking around.
sentences.zh: 托马斯和托辛都说他们根本不知道警察在暗中调查。

sentences.en: So when the cops burst into their dorm and arrested Tosin, it came as a complete surprise.
sentences.zh: 所以当警察突然闯入他们的宿舍逮捕托辛时，这完全是个意外。

sentences.en: So as far as in my mind, I'm thinking, okay, maybe I have a warrant for a ticket or I really didn't
sentences.zh: 所以在我的脑海里，我想的是，好吧，也许我有关于罚单的逮捕令，或者我真的

sentences.en: know what was going on.
sentences.zh: 不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: And so I asked him several times that, hey, can I call my dad?
sentences.zh: 所以我问了他们好几次，嘿，我可以给我爸爸打电话吗？

sentences.en: Like, I'm
sentences.zh: 就像，我

sentences.en: going to call my dad just to let him know what's going on.
sentences.zh: 要给我爸爸打电话，只是让他知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: Can I call my older brother?
sentences.zh: 我能给我哥哥打电话吗？

sentences.en: And they
sentences.zh: 而他们

sentences.en: wouldn't let me make any phone calls.
sentences.zh: 不让我打任何电话。

sentences.en: He says it wasn't until a couple of days later when Thomas
sentences.zh: 他说直到几天后托马斯

sentences.en: came to visit that he actually began to understand what was going on.
sentences.zh: 来探视时，他才真正开始明白发生了什么。

sentences.en: So I picked up the phone and
sentences.zh: 所以我拿起电话，

sentences.en: I was talking to him through the glass, and the first thing he asked me was, like, how am I?
sentences.zh: 隔着玻璃跟他说话，他问我的第一件事就是，我怎么样？

sentences.en: I said, I'm fine, man, just trying to figure out what's going on.
sentences.zh: 我说，我很好，老兄，只是在弄清楚发生了什么。

sentences.en: And then that's when he says, do you remember that night when we were writing and producing
sentences.zh: 然后就在那时他说，你还记得那天我们在写歌和制作音乐时，

sentences.en: and you wrote the thing about the PayPal account and the thing we got from the Law & Order episode?
sentences.zh: 你写了关于贝宝账户的事情以及我们从《法律与秩序》那一集里得到的东西吗？

sentences.en: And I was like, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我说，记得。

sentences.en: And then he says, that's what this is about.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，这就是为此而来的。

sentences.en: And so when he said that twice, he said, that's what this is about.
sentences.zh: 所以当他把这话说了两遍，他说，这就是为此而来的。

sentences.en: Tosin worried they thought he was a terroriSt.
sentences.zh: 托辛担心他们认为他是个恐怖分子。

sentences.en: And then came the charge for attempted terrorist threat.
sentences.zh: 接着就是企图制造恐怖威胁的指控。

sentences.en: I'd never heard of a charge like that before.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未听说过这样的指控。

sentences.en: You know, attempted terrorist threat.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，企图恐怖威胁。

sentences.en: Not a terrorist threat.
sentences.zh: 不是恐怖威胁。

sentences.en: Still, Tosin was sure the confusion would soon be cleared up.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，托辛确信误会很快就会澄清。

sentences.en: As soon as my dad gets here with our lawyer, we'll be able to explain this.
sentences.zh: 只要我爸爸带着我们的律师一到，我们就能够解释清楚这一切。

sentences.en: And, you know, and that'll be the end of it.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，事情就会结束了。

sentences.en: They made a mistake and we can go back to our lives.
sentences.zh: 他们犯了个错误，我们可以回到我们的生活中去。

sentences.en: But when the story hit the news, Tosun says everything got warped.
sentences.zh: 但当这个故事登上新闻时，托辛说一切都变味了。

sentences.en: They were saying a Nigerian citizen, Owutosun Oduale, and making it seem like I was like a foreigner that like came over here.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在说尼日利亚公民奥武托森·奥杜阿莱，把我搞得像个从外地来的外国人一样。

sentences.en: Just the way I was being portrayed as if like I was a terroriSt.
sentences.zh: 我被刻画成的那种形象，就好像我是个恐怖分子一样。

sentences.en: And of course, my name was mispronounced on purpose to make it sound really, really foreign and just different.
sentences.zh: 当然，我的名字被故意念错，好听起来非常、非常异国情调，而且与众不同。

sentences.en: and they were not describing me like I was a kid born and raised in St. Louis, Missouri.
sentences.zh: 他们根本不是把我描述成一个在密苏里州圣路易斯出生长大的孩子。

sentences.en: The news media kept harping on the note.
sentences.zh: 新闻媒体一直在拿这篇便条做文章。

sentences.en: They distorted it, Tosin says.
sentences.zh: 托辛说，他们歪曲了事实。

sentences.en: And so, yes, when you now paint it that way as a note and violence and guns,
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，当你把它描绘成一张便条、暴力和枪支时，

sentences.en: it's very easy to make anybody feel like, oh, yeah, this was one bad guy
sentences.zh: 很容易让人觉得，哦，是的，这家伙就是个坏蛋，

sentences.en: because you can craft information and make something appear the way you want to
sentences.zh: 因为如果你占据上风，

sentences.en: if you have the upper hand.
sentences.zh: 你就可以精心捏造信息，让事情呈现出你想要的样子。

sentences.en: Tosin says no one in law enforcement
sentences.zh: 托辛说，没有一个执法人员

sentences.en: wanted to hear his side of the story.
sentences.zh: 愿意听取他的说法。

sentences.en: Thomas Phillips felt the same.
sentences.zh: 托马斯·菲利普斯也有同感。

sentences.en: After police initially talked to Thomas,
sentences.zh: 警察最初找托马斯谈话后，

sentences.en: he tried to go back to them
sentences.zh: 他曾试图回去找他们，

sentences.en: and explain that they had it all wrong.
sentences.zh: 并解释说他们完全搞错了。

sentences.en: It's a shame that I can actually tell somebody,
sentences.zh: 真遗憾，我居然能对别人说——

sentences.en: like a law enforcement official,
sentences.zh: 比如执法官员，

sentences.en: after the initial interview,
sentences.zh: 在最初的讯问之后——

sentences.en: this is what actually has happened.
sentences.zh: 这才是实际发生的事情。

sentences.en: Can y'all add this to the story?
sentences.zh: 你们能把这个加到案情里吗？

sentences.en: And that no one's going to hear it
sentences.zh: 然而没有人会听，

sentences.en: because everybody's mind's already made up
sentences.zh: 因为大家心里已经认定

sentences.en: with what actually appears to be the case.
sentences.zh: 事情就是表面看到的那样了。

sentences.en: Why did that happen?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: There were lots of issues.
sentences.zh: 这里面有很多问题。

sentences.en: Race, culture, the fear of a mass shooting,
sentences.zh: 种族、文化、对大规模枪击案的恐惧，

sentences.en: and there was the music.
sentences.zh: 还有音乐。

sentences.en: After we ran the analysis,
sentences.zh: 在我们进行分析之后，

sentences.en: we found that in every dimension,
sentences.zh: 我们发现，在每一个维度上，

sentences.en: rap lyrics were evaluated more negatively
sentences.zh: 人们对说唱歌词的评价都更加负面，

sentences.en: compared to when the lyrics were perceived to be country.
sentences.zh: 相比于人们认为这些歌词是乡村音乐的时候。

sentences.en: Stay with us.
sentences.zh: 请继续收听。

sentences.en: A few months after Tosin was arrested, a visitor showed up to meet Jeffrey Erdangan,
sentences.zh: 托辛被捕几个月后，西北大学普里茨克法学院的教授兼律师杰弗里·埃达甘迎来了一位来访者。

sentences.en: a professor and lawyer at Northwestern University Pritzker School of Law.
sentences.zh: 他是西北大学普里茨克法学院的教授兼律师。

sentences.en: The man was Toyin Odawale, Tosin's father.
sentences.zh: 这个人是托辛的父亲托因·奥达瓦莱。

sentences.en: Toyin was unruffled and extremely poised and dignified.
sentences.zh: 托因镇定自若，极其沉着且有尊严。

sentences.en: Tosin's father wanted Jeffrey to take on his son's case.
sentences.zh: 托辛的父亲希望杰弗里接手他儿子的案子。

sentences.en: He was intrigued and agreed.
sentences.zh: 他很感兴趣并答应了。

sentences.en: Jeffrey drove five hours south to see Tosin at the Madison County Jail.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里驱车向南五小时，去麦迪逊县监狱探望托辛。

sentences.en: It was a contact visit because I was an attorney, and that was our first meeting.
sentences.zh: 因为我是律师，这是一次接触性会见，那是我们的第一次见面。

sentences.en: He was, if I recall, he was shackled at the ankles and handcuffed at his wrists.
sentences.zh: 如果我没记错的话，他当时脚上戴着脚镣，手腕戴着手铐。

sentences.en: And he was a quiet, young guy, great eye contact,
sentences.zh: 他是个安静的年轻人，眼神交流很好，

sentences.en: not particularly frightened like so many people are in that situation.
sentences.zh: 并没有像许多人在那种情况下那样特别害怕。

sentences.en: In light of the Virginia Tech massacre, Jeffrey says he understood why police suspected Tilson.
sentences.zh: 鉴于弗吉尼亚理工大学惨案，杰弗里说他理解警方为什么怀疑托辛。

sentences.en: But he says they should have quickly figured out that they were off track.

sentences.zh: 根据罪行等级，他因企图实施恐怖威胁被判处在惩教部服刑五年，并因非法持有武器在麦迪逊县监狱服刑一年。

sentences.en: Jeffrey Ordangan says the trial was a disaster.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里·奥尔丹根表示，这场审判是一场灾难。

sentences.en: It was a First Amendment train wreck, in my view.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这是一场宪法第一修正案的灾难。

sentences.en: Jeffrey sees two flaws in the prosecution's case.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里认为控方的案件存在两处硬伤。

sentences.en: First, the criminalized speech.
sentences.zh: 首先，他们将言论定为刑事犯罪。

sentences.en: By taking a work of art, something that was intended as a work of art,
sentences.zh: 通过拿走一件艺术品，一件本应作为艺术品的东西，

sentences.en: and distorted it into criminal intent.
sentences.zh: 并将其曲解为犯罪意图。

sentences.en: Second, he says, the criminalized thought.
sentences.zh: 其次，他说，他们将思想定为刑事犯罪。

sentences.en: By criminalizing thought, what I mean is we need to charge this man with a crime
sentences.zh: 通过将思想定罪，我的意思是我们需要指控这个人犯罪，

sentences.en: because for all we know, he was thinking about acting on what we surmise were evil intents,
sentences.zh: 因为据我们所知，他在考虑将我们推测的邪恶意图付诸行动，

sentences.en: even though we have no evidence that he intended to communicate that thought.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们没有任何证据表明他打算传达这种想法。

sentences.en: Tosin says his worst moment came after the trial at the Graham Correctional Center.
sentences.zh: 托辛说，他最糟糕的时刻是在审判结束后进入格雷厄姆惩教中心的时候。

sentences.en: They strip you naked.
sentences.zh: 他们脱光你的衣服。

sentences.en: They tell you to bend over.
sentences.zh: 他们叫你弯下腰。

sentences.en: They make sure you don't, you know, you're not sneaking in any weapons.
sentences.zh: 他们要确保你没有，你知道的，没有偷带任何武器。

sentences.en: Just a very degrading process.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常羞辱的过程。

sentences.en: And then when they put me in a cell, and then they lock the door, and then you hear the clink.
sentences.zh: 然后当他们把我关进牢房，锁上门，接着你听到咔哒一声。

sentences.en: And it's a small cell.
sentences.zh: 那是个很小的牢房。

sentences.en: It's like five by nine.
sentences.zh: 大约五乘九英尺。

sentences.en: There's two metal bunk beds in there, and it's you and another guy, and you just feel so claustrophobic.
sentences.zh: 里面有两个金属双层床，只有你和另一个家伙，你会感到无比的幽闭恐惧。

sentences.en: But you can't leave.
sentences.zh: 但你无法离开。

sentences.en: Tosin says it felt like being punched in the gut.
sentences.zh: 托辛说这感觉就像胃里挨了一拳。

sentences.en: Jeffrey Ordangan appealed the conviction.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里·奥尔丹根对定罪提起了上诉。

sentences.en: A year and a half later, the case came before an appellate court.
sentences.zh: 一年半后，案件来到了上诉法院。

sentences.en: The conviction for the terrorist charge was overturned.
sentences.zh: 恐怖主义指控的定罪被推翻了。

sentences.en: The court said, in the absence of sufficient evidence
sentences.zh: 法院表示，在缺乏充分证据

sentences.en: that the defendant had taken a substantial step toward making a terrorist threat,
sentences.zh: 证明被告采取了实质性步骤来发出恐怖威胁的情况下，

sentences.en: his writings, as abhorrent as they might be, amount to mere thoughts.
sentences.zh: 他的文字无论多么令人反感，都只属于单纯的想法。

sentences.en: Since Tosin's case went to trial, there have been many other cases
sentences.zh: 自从托辛的案子进入审判以来，还有许多其他案件

sentences.en: in which rap artists have had their lyrics introduced as evidence in criminal proceedings.
sentences.zh: 说唱歌手的歌词被作为证据引入刑事诉讼程序。

sentences.en: Criminologist Sharice Kubrin.
sentences.zh: 犯罪学家沙里丝·库布林。

sentences.en: Not a lot of people know that this is happening.
sentences.zh: 很多人并不知道这件事正在发生。

sentences.en: I don't think we quite understand the implications of using rap lyrics as evidence
sentences.zh: 我认为我们还没有完全理解将说唱歌词作为证据使用的影响，

sentences.en: and what that means for defendants.
sentences.zh: 以及这对被告意味着什么。

sentences.en: Like, can they get a fair trial?
sentences.zh: 比如，他们能得到公正的审判吗？

sentences.en: Can we ensure that their First Amendment rights are protected
sentences.zh: 我们能否确保他们的第一修正案权利受到保护，

sentences.en: when these lyrics have the potential to bias jurors?
sentences.zh: 当这些歌词有可能使陪审团产生偏见时？

sentences.en: When I met him at his home in New Jersey,
sentences.zh: 当我在他位于新泽西州的家中见到他时，

sentences.en: Olutosen Oduwale was 31 years old.
sentences.zh: 奥卢托森·奥杜瓦利31岁。

sentences.en: He says the trial, the conviction, the prison time,
sentences.zh: 他说那场审判、定罪、牢狱之灾，

sentences.en: he's put all of that behind him.
sentences.zh: 他都已经抛在脑后了。

sentences.en: But one thing still upsets him,
sentences.zh: 但有一件事仍然让他感到不安，

sentences.en: having lyrics he considers embarrassingly bad attached to his name.
sentences.zh: 那就是被贴上了他认为尴尬且糟糕的歌词在自己名下的标签。

sentences.en: There's a lot of stuff that you will never hear,
sentences.zh: 有很多东西你永远听不到，

sentences.en: that you will never see,
sentences.zh: 你永远看不到，

sentences.en: because I either didn't think it was good
sentences.zh: 因为要么我觉得它不好，

sentences.en: or I didn't think it would be received well.
sentences.zh: 要么我觉得它不会受欢迎。

sentences.zh: 这本该是那种

sentences.en: that the world was never supposed to see
sentences.zh: 世界永远不该看到

sentences.en: or hear.
sentences.zh: 或听到的东西。

sentences.zh: 他依然是个音乐人，

sentences.zh: 引起了关注。
